thread:
Aria (CS): quick capture from Cedar onboarding call this morning. Finance wants a single 'cost transparency' artifact: an on-demand per-route CSV + a short mapping doc to their ledger codes before renewal.
Dan (PM): good catch. put the exact columns here and we'll spec a minimal MVP.
Aria (CS): they asked for: account_id,project,route_name,route_id,model,request_count,token_total,net_cost,currency_code,start_date,end_date,cost_center. also need a sample row using GBP.
Mika (Eng): fine. do they want scheduled S3/SFTP drops or ad hoc downloads?
Aria (CS): ad hoc download first, scheduled nightly as follow-up. SFTP would be a later ask.
Rohit (Product): other asks from the call?
Aria (CS): yes 1) ability to set a default, lower-cost model per-team (support wants this), 2) an alert when embeddings for a dataset haven't been refreshed in 30 days.
Dan (PM): prioritize export + enablement as P1 because they tied it directly to their renewal decision. default-model per-team = P2. embeddings-staleness alert = P2.
Mika (Eng): estimate for CSV endpoint + background spool + basic UI to trigger export: ~6 dev days + 2 QA days if we keep it simple. Adding SFTP doubles infra time.
CS-Bot: Ticket CS-4332 created: "Cedar - per-route cost export and enablement" tags: [billing,export,renewal-risk].
Dan (PM): thanks. Mika, can you add an API surface (GET /accounts/{id}/billing/export/{id}) and a sample CSV header into CS-4332? Include auth scope.
Mika (Eng): will do. I'll include a sample row with GBP and currency_code=GBP as requested.
Aria (CS): enablement asks: 20-min walkthrough for finance + one-pager with column->GL mapping. we'll need a sample CSV that mirrors their dataset for the walkthrough.
Rohit (Product): add a success metric on the ticket: percent of renewal accounts that download a CSV within 14 days. If we can make that >50% it should reduce churn risk.
Dan (PM): timeline proposal: spec in ticket by Thu EOD, eng tickets ready Mon next week, beta demo for customer in 2 weeks.
Aria (CS): I'll coordinate scheduling once you have a beta link. also asked for currency normalization note in the doc (how we round and apply exchange rates).
Mika (Eng): we'll add currency_code and a normalized_cost column and document rounding rules.
Dan (PM): great. default-model per-team will be a small UX change in team settings. put that on the backlog with P2.
Aria (CS): thanks all. I'll post the call recording and the finance sample mapping into the ticket when I upload it. :thumbsup:
Mika (Eng): :thumbsup: ping us if they need a CSV sample earlier for procurement.
CS-Bot: Reaction: :white_check_mark:
